subject: npmx Weekly #23
headline: npmx Weekly #23
intro: Exciting developments are underway at npmx! Dive into our latest updates that showcase community engagement and product enhancements.

topics.title: Community Engagement
topics.summary: npmx is fostering community involvement by encouraging participation in project verification efforts. Positive feedback highlights the importance of community support in scaling these initiatives.

topics.title: Release Updates
topics.summary: The new v0.16.0 update has been released for npmx.dev, featuring UI enhancements, improved translations, and exciting new functionalities like the downloads chart embed for a better user experience.

topics.title: Module Replacements Update
topics.summary: The release of module-replacements 3.0.0 marks a significant milestone with over 400K downloads weekly, further powering numerous tools, including the ESLint plugin and package help text on npmx.dev.
